lists.name: founding-alone
lists.why: one root, as every build pinned before the list: it is current and nothing is retired

lists.name: cross-signed-successor
lists.why: the successor is endorsed by the root before it; the founding root is retired when the successor's validity begins

lists.name: unendorsed-impostor
lists.why: the impostor endorsed itself; nothing in the list endorsed it

lists.name: impostor-without-endorsement
lists.why: every root after the first carries its predecessor's endorsement

lists.name: impostor-with-anothers-endorsement
lists.why: the founding root endorsed the successor's envelope, not the impostor's

lists.name: reversed
lists.why: a root cannot begin before the root that endorsed it: the order is the order of succession

lists.name: listed-twice
lists.why: a key id is listed once

lists.name: endorsed-first-root
lists.why: the first root is pinned as code; an endorsement there names a root the list does not hold

lists.name: empty
lists.why: a list names at least one root
